newsitem.title: USA: Texas Instruments to unveil new chip - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Texas Instruments to unveil new chip - WSJ.

text.p: Next week Texas Instruments Inc plans to introduce a computer chip that can process 1.6 billion instructions per second, the Wall Street Journal said Friday.
The new digital-signal processor has about 40 times the processing power of a comparable chip in an ordinary computer modem, the paper said.
Digital signal processors, or DPSs, are used in compact-disk players, wireless phones and other audiovisual equipment.
A company executive told the paper that the chip does not move information between two places faster, but lets more information be transmitted simultaneously.
The paper said the new chip can handle signals from 24 calls at once, an operation that previously required 24 chips.
Texas Instruments shares closed Thursday at 74-5/8.
